target: zhes bya ba dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnam pa gsum dang / sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i dus las mi 'da' ba'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos nyid dang / nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa'i bag la nyal gyi ngo bo'i sa bon spangs pas bag chags yang dag par bcom pa dang / skye bo mtha' dag la phan pa'i bsam pa nyid ces bya ba skye bo la thugs rje chen po nyid dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brgyad dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang / dang zhes bya ba'i sgras bsdus pa lam shes pa nyid la sogs pa sngar bshad pa dag kyang yin te/

target: gtan du phan pa dang / sdug bsngal gyi rgyu bzlog pa dang / 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa dang / rang dang gzhan gyi don rtogs pa'i rten gyi ngo bo dang / gzhan gyi don sgrub pa dang / sems can gyi don lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa dang / theg pa gsum gyi nges par 'byung ba'i 'bras bu mngon sum du mi byed pa zhes bya ba 'di rnams dus ji lta ba bzhin du yang dag par nye bar sgrub pa'i don gyis lam shes pa nyid kyi skyabs la sogs pa'i byed pa bdun no/ / theg gsum gyi zhes pa ni sems can gyi don bya ba'i phyir theg pa gsum gyis nges par 'byung ba'i/ 'bras bu mngon sum mi byed bdag / ces pa ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyi 'bras bu dag rnam pa thams cad du mngon sum mi byed pa dang / sems can gyi don bya ba'i phyir tshogs yongs su rdzogs par mi byed kyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi 'bras bu yang mngon sum du mi byed pa ste/
